title: laureliopsis philippiana

It is a native plant of the temperate rainforests of Chile and Argentina. The health benefits of Laureliopsis philippiana include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to support cardiovascular health and reduce oxidative stress.
